title: Convergence Rates for Laws of Large Numbers: Chebyshev, CLT, Berry-Esseen
description: Formalizes quantitative convergence rates for the law of large numbers. Proves Chebyshev rate (P(|X̄ₙ - μ| ≥ ε) ≤ σ²/(nε²)) from Mathlib's Chebyshev inequality. Axiomatizes CLT (requires characteristic functions, not in Mathlib v4.26) and Berry-Esseen bound. Proves rate ordering and that Chebyshev rate implies WLLN. 3 axioms. 8 theorems.

meta.author: Lean Genius Research
meta.assumptions: 3 axioms: CLT (characteristic functions needed), Berry-Esseen bound, moment conditions.

overview.historicalContext: Chebyshev (1867) proved the WLLN quantitatively. CLT (Lindeberg 1922) gives the precise 1/√n scale. Berry-Esseen gives explicit CLT error bounds.
overview.problemStatement: Prove quantitative LLN convergence rates and the CLT-WLLN connection.
overview.proofStrategy: Chebyshev rate from Var(X̄ₙ) = σ²/n + Mathlib Chebyshev inequality; CLT and Berry-Esseen axiomatized.
